08-hopping-logo.reply:
I made the 4-second 1920×1080 sting on a warm off-white background with one orange-red accent. The ball drops in from the upper left, lands, then bounces three more times across the floor, each bounce lower and shorter, with a small squash on each landing and a soft floor shadow. It rests at centre just above "HOPSCOTCH", which rises in letter by letter under it. The orange-red paper plane glides in from the right, flies a full loop through three points in the sky, and settles above the wordmark to the right of the ball.

I checked contact sheets of the animation but didn't play the exported video back. I added no sound. I skipped nothing from the brief, though I counted the first landing as the start of the three bounces.
